```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(readr)

# -------------------------
# Step 1: Load the Data
# -------------------------

# Load expression data
expr <- read.delim("/Users/andrea/MolProf/TCGA-BRCA.star_fpkm.tsv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# Load clinical matrix
clinical <- read.delim("/Users/andrea/MolProf/BRCA_clinicalMatrix", row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# Transpose clinical data to match sample orientation
#clinical <- as.data.frame(t(clinical))
#clinical$sample_id <- rownames(clinical)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# Step 2: Filter HER2+ Tumors and Normals
# -------------------------
# Remove anything after the fourth dash (e.g., "-01A-01R" -> "-01A")
clean_ids <- gsub("^(TCGA-\\w{2}-\\w{4}-\\w{3}).*", "\\1", colnames(expr))

# Apply cleaned names
colnames(expr) <- clean_ids


# Create sample group labels
clinical_filtered <- clinical %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% c("Primary Tumor", "Solid Tissue Normal")) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_group = case_when(
      sample_type == "Solid Tissue Normal" ~ "Normal",
      sample_type == "Primary Tumor" & HER2_Final_Status_nature2012 == "Positive" ~ "HER2_Positive",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample_group))

# Subset expression data to matching samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr), clinical_filtered$sample_id)
expr_filtered <- expr[, common_samples]
clinical_filtered <- clinical_filtered %>% filter(sample_id %in% colnames(expr_filtered))

# Match order
expr_filtered <- expr_filtered[, clinical_filtered$sample_id]
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# Step 3: Differential Expression (limma-voom)
# -------------------------

group <- factor(clinical_filtered$sample_group)
design <- model.matrix(~0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

dge <- DGEList(counts = expr_filtered)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
v <- voom(dge, design)

fit <- lmFit(v, design)
contrast <- makeContrasts(HER2_Positive - Normal, levels = design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

top_genes <- topTable(fit2, adjust = "fdr", number = Inf)
write.csv(top_genes, "HER2_vs_Normal_DEGs.csv")
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Filter significant genes
sig_genes <- top_genes %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 1)
write.csv(sig_genes, "HER2_vs_Normal_Significant_DEGs.csv")

head(sig_genes)
```
